name: ANSI/IEEE heating element symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for heating element, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The heater-element form identifies a documented resistive heating load. Supply conductors, control thermostat and protective device should be read as separate elements, even when the drawing places them close together to explain the heater circuit.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Read heater load and thermostat action independently.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A heating element is a power-consuming load, whereas the thermostat is a control or measuring element.
